summary: EQT Corporation filed an 8-K on October 7, 2026, reporting establishment of a $3.5 billion commercial paper program under Section 4(a)(2) exemption, with notes of up to 397-day maturities sold at par or discount through one or more dealers and a national bank as issuing/paying agent. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes including working capital, capex, acquisitions and debt repayment. EQT's senior unsecured revolving credit facility backstops the program; no notes have been issued. This is a routine financing-arrangement disclosure, not a special situation; watch CP balances and revolver capacity headroom.
